description: Myanmar Road Network is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Myanmar Information Management Unit (MIMU). Road network with main, secondary and tertiary roads. This network-based connectivity approach mainly uses population centres, such as, Union capital, State/Region capital, Main town, other town and village location, as the bases to road network. Main Road links ST/R Capital to Main Towns and to Neighbouring countries. Coverage: Myanmar. The portal files it under the publisher Myanmar Information Management Unit (MIMU). Its tags are geodata, roads, transportation. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEOJSON, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
